purpose: Cross-chapter defaults; no hidden implementation choices. Main PRD formulas still apply.

ownership.incoming_cargo: not_ready_food_until_unloaded; exclude from destination protection before arrival

actors.constant_resident_meal_count: ordinary residents plus settled heroes, not visitors or camp recruits
actors.agent_task_swap: finish safe cargo handoff before reassignment

construction_selection.condition_inputs: read actual state at planner boundary; one candidate per absent or upgradeable building type

priority_rules.condition: founding hall repair unfinished and not already live
food cover below 90% for two meals and all current crop beds committed; farm below level3 and city beds below12
population+2 exceeds housing, house count below4 or an existing house below3
market absent and no market project live
stock volume including incoming above90% of total capacity
authorized project requires planks/tools and current production station is absent
population at least24 or more than4 agents waiting for meal service
legion authorized and camp capacity below authorized size
current unique wish is mount and stable absent
regional goal authorized or discovered guanyu wish selected; station absent

construction_selection.no_matching_candidate: no ordinary project; evaluate civic policy projects and normal production
construction_selection.safety_filter: funding, raw reserves, actual land, phase materials, labor and authority must all pass

collection_bootstrap.condition: discovered active wish requires workshop or tavern missing
collection_bootstrap.rule: consider the required building only if funding and civilian protection pass; do not automatically change the wish
